attributes.title: Server-side Request Availability
attributes.description: Per-service request availability derived as the absence of span-derived 5xx faults. This measures server-side request success, not Kubernetes replica, host, or infrastructure availability.

attributes.title: Recent Pod Restarts
attributes.description: Application pods with one or more container restarts during the last 5 minutes. Only configured application namespaces are included.

attributes.title: Application Traffic
attributes.description: Current span-derived request volume by service. The request metric is a windowed derived metric and is used directly rather than converted with rate().

attributes.title: 4xx Error Rate
attributes.description: Percentage of application requests represented by span-derived 4xx errors, grouped by service.

attributes.title: 5xx Fault Rate
attributes.description: Percentage of application requests represented by span-derived 5xx faults, grouped by service.

attributes.title: Memory vs Requests
attributes.description: Top application pods by working-set memory as a percentage of configured memory requests. Pods without a positive memory request are excluded.

attributes.title: CPU Throttling
attributes.description: Top application pods by CPU throttling percentage over 5 minutes, calculated from throttled scheduling periods versus total CPU scheduling periods.

attributes.title: CPU vs Requests
attributes.description: Top application pods by CPU utilization as a percentage of configured CPU requests. Pods without a positive CPU request are excluded.

attributes.title: CPU vs Limits
attributes.description: Top application pods by CPU utilization as a percentage of configured CPU limits. Pods without a positive CPU limit are excluded.

attributes.title: Memory vs Limits
attributes.description: Top application pods by working-set memory as a percentage of configured memory limits. Pods without a positive memory limit are excluded.

attributes.title: Unavailable Replicas
attributes.description: Application deployments currently reporting unavailable replicas. Healthy deployments with zero unavailable replicas are omitted.

attributes.title: Top Workloads by CPU
attributes.description: Top application pods by current CPU consumption, measured in CPU cores using a 5-minute rate.

attributes.title: Top Workloads by Memory
attributes.description: Top application pods by current working-set memory consumption in GiB.

attributes.title: Workload Network Receive
attributes.description: Top application pods by network receive throughput in MiB/s over 5 minutes.

attributes.title: Workload Network Transmit
attributes.description: Top application pods by network transmit throughput in MiB/s over 5 minutes.
